purpose: Source-grounded training curriculum for an automated player; not evidence of completed gameplay.

training.name: Moving Rock Raiders
training.validation: Confirm movement from in-game state or two time-separated game-window observations

training.name: Rock Types And Drilling
training.validation: Verify target wall changes state; a click by itself does not prove drilling

training.name: Building Rock Raider HQ
training.validation: Verify completed building and resources consumed

training.name: Moving Rock Raider Vehicles
training.validation: Verify vehicle displacement without relying solely on the cursor

training.name: Using Explosives
training.validation: Verify obstruction cleared while units remain safe

training.name: Constructing Advanced Buildings
training.validation: Verify original objective and building completion

training.name: Drilling With Vehicles
training.validation: Verify mining progress from actual mission or captured state

training.name: Defending Rock Raider HQ
training.validation: Verify HQ survives the tutorial's threat

progression_rule: Do not mark an exercise learned until the original Windows game has produced validated evidence. Static references alone are not gameplay.
